[NERR.9.1] -550 to -553 are reserved and never reused ([IERR.2.8b]): a runtime
of this edition skips every `CompiledCode` atom and decodes none
([RDSC.4c.3]). -520 to -527 are reserved and never reused ([IERR.2.8a]).

The op check that *does* happen at load — a builtin call naming an op
with no registered handler — surfaces as `DS_ERR_FN_NOT_FOUND`,
censused at [NERR.10.1] and not duplicated here.
